descripcion: Funds projects that strengthen food and educational security in a single territory. Priority is given to proposals from several organizations that already work together.

requisitos.descripcion: Serve at least 1000 people in the same district, counted together
Have transport capacity of your own for distribution
Have refrigerated storage for perishable food
Have physical space for training and workshops
Have an educational component aimed at the community
Show documented prior collaboration between the applying organizations
